title: Air Flow Paths
description: HVAC zone definitions, cross-zone links, and adjacency graph for CONTAM-style multi-zone aerosol transport.

oa_fraction.description: Default outdoor-air fraction for Contam-aligned HVAC recirculation (native twin). Contam OAFrac default is 0.2.

hvac_duty.description: Default AHU duty multiplier on supply total (1.0 = design Fahs). Set 0.5 to match Contam hobbyist night/steady ContamX frames.

rooms.description: Room IDs that MUST exist in spatial_layout.json

ach.description: Air changes per hour for this HVAC zone

oa_fraction.description: Outdoor-air fraction for Contam-aligned recirculation (overrides top-level)

hvac_duty.description: AHU duty multiplier on supply/return (1.0 = design; Contam hobbyist night ≈ 0.5)

filter_efficiency.description: Advisory-only annotation: NOT consumed by the native engine or the ContamX export. Filtration is a single global hvac.filter_efficiency scalar in both lanes; per-zone filtration (citadel) is inexpressible until it is modelled (CONTAM-FLEET-01 recorded gap).

nbc_filter_efficiency.description: Advisory-only annotation: NOT consumed in either lane; documents intended NBC/citadel filtration until per-zone filtration is expressible (CONTAM-FLEET-01 recorded gap).

nbc_filter_type.description: Advisory-only annotation: NOT consumed in either lane; documents intended NBC filter media until per-zone filtration is expressible (CONTAM-FLEET-01 recorded gap).

from.description: Source zone or HVAC zone ID

to.description: Destination zone or HVAC zone ID

is_hvac_ducted.description: Whether airflow passes through HVAC filtration

direction.description: Declared direction (CONTAM-BIDIR-01). Absent: ducted links are one-way fan legs, passive links are bidirectional like the ContamX orifice they export as. Pin "oneway" on a genuinely directed link.

type.description: Adjacency link type (e.g. passageway, ladder_well, turbolift)
